title: Fix Ring Row Tree Header Alignment in Sketchpad Details
description: Fix the Ring row in compose/sketchpad Details panel to follow shared TreeItem header structure: correct label alignment, action placement, gutter/chevron spacing, no drift into value column. Apply generically at shared Details panel tree layout level.
summary: Added a shared Label fallback for tree-group headers so missing translations still render a visible title from the id token (e.g. `...connectors.ring` -> `Ring`). This fixes the missing Ring header name while keeping the previously implemented shared tree-header alignment. Updated the ring tree-header test to use the plural id and validate `Ring` renders. Verified with `npm test --workspace elements/ui` (33 tests passing).
